_comment: The talk_pool_stages seam's own end-to-end proof (spec QA §2): drives ONE NPC (Krshia -- cheapest live choice, pool+perk both shipped) base->final through the new talk_pool_stages seam. FIXTURE-FIRST (krshia_stage3_pre: crate_returned:1, chatted_with_krshia:3, social_talked:{krshia:true} -- one leg short of stage 3, mid-waking so the FIRST interact opens her REAL hub instead of a pool line). Proves, in order: (1) BEFORE -- the stage-3 hub topic is genuinely absent at count 3 (exact-length visible-options array); (2) the run banks the LAST leg for real via one first-talk-of-a-NEW-waking pool line (exact staged stage-1 line, since the gate is read BEFORE this call's own counter bump) -- sleep is driven via a debug teleport to the inn bed (short-circuits the long street->inn walk any organic route would need, in the spirit of FIXTURE-FIRST); (3) AFTER -- the stage-3 hub topic is now present (same exact-length-array idiom) and choosing it fires the OBLIQUE necklace reveal + banks heard_krshia_plans; (4) the perk surface -- the shop node's full-price rows are gone and the friend's-price duplicates stand in their place (affordability greying still independent of the stage gate, per gold:10 in the fixture: the charm ungreys, the pricier three stay locked).

steps._comment: == BEFORE: social_talked[krshia] is already true (fixture), so this FIRST interact falls straight through to the REAL hub -- no pool line consumed. At count 3 the stage-3 topic is genuinely absent: exact-length 3-entry visible array (shop-nav/just-visiting/tribe-topic only).
steps.name: interact

payload_contains.speaker: Krshia
payload_contains.text: Crate is home. You, I will remember. Yes.

options.text: You said the necklace was a promise.

steps._comment: == BANK THE LAST LEG FOR REAL, via a debug teleport to the inn bed (FIXTURE-FIRST short-circuit of the organic street<->inn walk) rather than re-deriving a full route. Bump the bed (2,7) from (2,6) facing down, interact -> sleep().
Teleport back to Krshia's column and re-approach exactly as the fixture originally placed the player.

sleep() cleared social_talked, so this NEW waking's first talk plays the pool. The stage gate reads BEFORE this call's own counter bump: chatted_with_krshia is STILL 3 at gate-check time, so stage 1 (krshia_fair_weight) wins, idx 3%%3=0 -- the exact staged line. This same call then bumps the counter to 4.
steps.name: interact

payload_contains.speaker: Krshia
payload_contains.text: Hrr. The crate-finder. Sit, look, touch even. You have earned handling privileges.
Krshia: Hrr. The crate-finder. Sit, look, touch even. You have earned handling privileges.

steps._comment: == AFTER: SECOND interact this same (new) waking falls through to the real hub -- chatted_with_krshia is now 4, so the stage-3 topic is present (4-entry visible array, exact length).
steps.name: interact

payload_contains.speaker: Krshia
payload_contains.text: Crate is home. You, I will remember. Yes.

options.text: You said the necklace was a promise.

steps._comment: Choose the newly-unlocked topic (visible index 3) -- the OBLIQUE necklace reveal, banks heard_krshia_plans.

payload_contains.speaker: Krshia
payload_contains.text: So you remembered. Hrr. Then hear a little of it. Every coin this stall clears past its keep goes toward something for the tribes. Something Gnolls have been told we cannot have, and are done being told. There is a gathering, some years off. I mean to stand up at it with full hands. That stays between you, me, and the wool.

steps._comment: 'Back to business.' (visible index 1) returns to hub.

== PERK SURFACE: 'What's on the stall today?' (visible index 0 -- heard_krshia_plans now banked, so the necklace topic itself is hide_when-retired; the hub's visible array is back to 3 entries with the tribe topic still showing) opens the shop. Full-price rows are hide_when-hidden (stage gate met); the 4 friend's-price duplicates stand in their place. gold:10 ungreys only the charm.
steps.name: confirm

options.text: The old charm-cord, friend's price. (4 gold)
That Silverfang hunting knife, friend's price. (13 gold)
The wool-lined cloak, friend's price. (16 gold)
The boiled-leather jerkin, friend's price. (22 gold)

'Just visiting.' is visible index 1 in the reverted 3-entry hub list.
